motion: I THEREFORE MOVE that City Council instruct the Bureau of Sanitation (LASAN) to report back within 30 days on its policy and procedures for Operation Healthy Streets (OHS) operation notifications and recommendations on howto enhance the notification process overall. This report should include: • A description of whether a formal notification system exists for OHS in Skid Row and if so, the methods, advance notice timelines, and staffing provided. • An assessment of the current OHS map for Skid Row, including its accuracy, clarity and how it is distributed to residents in the area. • An assessment of inconsistencies in notification practices between OHS CARE and OHS CARE+ operations. • An analysis of whether reliance on permanent metal signage contributes to gaps or inconsistencies in notifying residents of scheduled OHS operations. • An assessment of the costs of removing permanent metal signage and the staffing needed to post paper notices and proper documentation. I FURTHER MOVE that City Council instruct LASAN to develop recommendations to improve notification procedures. - C L x ■> PRESENTED By 47 • [AA CYSABEL URADO SECONDED BY:.
